mentions.name: Truly Typed
mentions.description: This document writing app makes it easy to see how a document was created. Each document carries provenance information such as how much of the content was actually typed, how much was pasted, how many sources were used, and how many authors contributed. Documents also carry authenticity flags such as "verified human," "bot detected," and "unverified" (used when a human transcribes text from another tab or book). The core thesis is that purely human-generated thoughts will matter more and more.
mentions.problem: It is hard to tell how a document was created — how much was typed by a human, pasted, or produced by a bot — while purely human-generated writing is becoming more valuable.
